question: What result is attributed to performing oblation with flowers of the brahma tree?
premises: Oblation is performed with flowers of the brahma tree
The oblation is evaluated for its effect
The stated effect is the giving of prosperity
inference: Oblation with flowers of the brahma tree is considered to grant prosperity
uncertainties: The specific plant intended by brahmavṛkṣa may vary by tradition
plain_english: And oblation with flowers of the brahma tree is considered to grant prosperity.
